facts.text: John expressed interest in reading a book during his travels and shared a photo of his bookshelf.

evidence.quote: Thanks! I'll definitely check it out - looks like a great book to read while traveling. Can't wait to dive into it! Here's a photo of my bookshelf.

facts.text: Tim noted that John had "The Alchemist" on his bookshelf and asked if he enjoyed it.

evidence.quote: Great bookshelf! I saw that you had "The Alchemist" on there, one of my favorites. Did you enjoy it?

facts.text: John confirmed that he read and loved "The Alchemist", and described its impact on his thinking.

evidence.quote: Yep, I read that book and loved it! It made me think about life and how important it is to follow one's dreams.

facts.text: Tim expressed satisfaction that John enjoyed "The Alchemist" and affirmed its value.

evidence.quote: Glad you liked it! "The Alchemist" is worth it.
